subject.title: fix(nodes): resolve Unicode browser node names when configured by display name

question: Should this PR remain blocked until a real connected browser-capable node proves final-head Unicode selector routing, or should the focused tests and in-process resolver probe receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: The patch is source-correct with no remaining actionable finding, but OpenClaw policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external non-docs PRs and no such evidence is present.

options.title: Require connected-node proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted final-head gateway or node output shows the configured Unicode selector invokes browser.proxy on the intended connected node.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the focused gateway regression test and resolver probe as sufficient evidence for this narrow matching change.

recommendation.title: Require connected-node proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted final-head gateway or node output shows the configured Unicode selector invokes browser.proxy on the intended connected node.
